title: Functions with defaults
description:
Write functions with optional and many arguments.

```
greet("Ada")                -> Hello, Ada!
greet("Ada", "Welcome")     -> Welcome, Ada!
sum(1, 2, 3, 4)             -> 10
average()                   -> nil
min_max(4, 9, 2)            -> 2  9
```

starter.main.lua:
local function greet(name, greeting)
  return "Hello, " .. name .. "!"
end

local function sum(...)
  return 0
end

print(greet("Ada"))
print(sum(1, 2, 3, 4))

hints: `local values = { ... }` turns the extra arguments into a list; `return lo, hi` returns two results.
stretch: Write `apply(f, ...)` that calls `f` on each argument and returns all the results.
